title: Demo enablement rollout + certification (required) — switching to Demo Deck v1
content:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>; Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>; Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>; Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>; Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>; Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>; Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Nov 20, 2025 at 4:12 PM PT
Subject: Demo enablement rollout + certification (required) — switching to Demo Deck v1

Team —

We’re rolling out the standardized demo tenant + Demo Deck v1 + talk track. Starting in December, this becomes the default for AE/SE demos.

What’s changing:
- One “known-good” demo tenant flow (seeded data + dashboards that are not empty)
- New canonical deck + talk track + backup mode assets
- Required certification for anyone running live demos (AE or SE)

Training (required):
1) Live training #1 (NA-friendly): Tue 12/03 10:00–11:15am PT
2) Live training #2 (EMEA-friendly): Thu 12/05 16:00–17:15 CET (Lukas hosting)

Certification (required):
- Complete checklist + a 10-min recorded run-through OR a live run-through with Markus’s team
- Deadline: Fri 12/13 EOD local

Cutover:
- New deck required for all external demos starting Mon 12/16
- Old deck deprecated after Fri 12/20 (exceptions only w/ SE leadership approval)

Where to find everything:
- Drive folder (deck + talk track + run-of-show + backup screenshots): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DemoEnablementRolloutV1
- Confluence hub (runbooks, FAQ, reset/healthcheck): https://redwoodinference.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SE/pages/DEMO-Enablement-Rollout-v1
- Slack: #demo-ops (use for questions + day-of-demo issues): https://redwoodinference.slack.com/archives/CDEMOOPS

Attachments:
- Redwood_Demo_Deck_v1.0.pdf
- Demo_Certification_Checklist_v1.docx
- Demo_Run_of_Show_30min_v1.docx

Please reply-all with:
1) Whether you’re planning to certify as “can run demo solo” vs “AE w/ SE support”
2) Which training you’ll attend

Thanks — we’re doing this to eliminate the brittle parts that have burned us (quota surprises, auth hiccups, empty dashboards, model changes).

Stephanie Nguyen
VP Sales, North America
Redwood Inference

---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>; Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>; Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>; Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>; Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>; Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Nov 20, 2025 at 4:28 PM PT
Subject: Re: Demo enablement rollout + certification (required) — switching to Demo Deck v1

+1.

Two practical questions:
1) Are we requiring certification for AEs who only do “narration + handoff” (i.e., SE drives keyboard)?
2) Parallel demos: do we have guidance yet on “one demo per SE per day” vs using isolated projects/keys? (We’ve had collisions.)

I can staff the live run-through slots, but I want the pass/fail criteria super explicit so we’re consistent.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Sales Engineering Manager (Demo Owner)

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>; Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>; Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>; Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>; Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>; Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>; Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Nov 20, 2025 at 4:41 PM PT
Subject: Re: Demo enablement rollout + certification (required) — switching to Demo Deck v1

On (1): I’d strongly prefer we certify anyone who is customer-facing in the demo, even if they’re not driving. The “talk track” is where we’ve seen inconsistency (esp. production economics + reliability).

Also flagging: we updated wording on the “Optimize” section to avoid the naming confusion we’ve been hearing. If anyone has existing personal slide variants, please stop using them after cutover — we’ll keep the canonical deck tight.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Product Marketing

---

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>; Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>; Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>; Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>; Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>; Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Nov 20, 2025 at 4:53 PM PT
Subject: Re: Demo enablement rollout + certification (required) — switching to Demo Deck v1

Confirming design/logistics:
- We’ll treat v1.0 as “frozen” for December.
- If we find issues, we’ll patch as v1.0.1 (same narrative, minimal slide movement) so certification doesn’t churn.

Also: can we ask folks to stop exporting their own PDFs? We should have ONE PDF in the shared folder so what’s emailed to prospects is consistent and always the latest.

Camila
Camila Reyes
Marketing

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>; Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>; Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>; Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>; Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>; Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>; Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Nov 21, 2025 at 7:18 AM CET
Subject: Re: Demo enablement rollout + certification (required) — switching to Demo Deck v1

Works for EMEA.

Request: can we explicitly include an “EMEA/data residency & Private” branch in certification? Even if it’s mostly narrative, reps get stuck without a crisp script.

For the 12/05 CET training, I can host, but I’ll need whoever owns the security/Private screenshots to confirm what’s safe to show.

— Lukas
Lukas Meyer
VP Sales, EMEA

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>; Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>; Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>; Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>; Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>; Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>; Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Nov 20, 2025 at 11:37 PM PT
Subject: Re: Demo enablement rollout + certification (required) — switching to Demo Deck v1

Quick answers:

Markus (certification scope):
- Yes, certify AEs even if not driving. The goal is consistent positioning + clean handoffs.
- We’ll have two “tracks”:
  A) AE-certified (talk track, discovery questions, objection paths, handoff cues)
  B) SE-certified (full run: reset/healthcheck + live steps)

Parallel demos:
- Short-term: assume isolated project + scoped key per scheduled demo.
- Markus: please add a line in the certification checklist to confirm the rep knows how to request/confirm isolated keys (via #demo-ops).

Lukas (EMEA branch):
- Yes. We’ll add a required “EMEA branch” module in certification (5 min) focusing on data residency, audit logs, retention controls, and Private/VPC architecture narrative.
- Soojin/Camila: please mark the specific slides/screenshots that are safe to show and any “do not share” notes.

Camila (single PDF):
- Agree. We’ll have a single exported PDF in the shared folder labeled “LATEST” and a dated archive for internal reference.

Also: I’m putting a hard stop on ad hoc deck edits in the field. If you need a slide change, route through Soojin/Camila and we’ll patch as v1.0.1.

Stephanie

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>; Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>; Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>; Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>; Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>; Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Nov 21, 2025 at 9:06 AM PT
Subject: Re: Demo enablement rollout + certification (required) — switching to Demo Deck v1

I’m in for AE-certified.

One request: can we have a defined “20-min exec demo” path (which slides to skip + which live step is safest)? I’m getting more exec sponsors and the full run-of-show is too long.

— Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Executive

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>; Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>; Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>; Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>; Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>; Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>; Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Nov 21, 2025 at 9:22 AM PT
Subject: Re: Demo enablement rollout + certification (required) — switching to Demo Deck v1

DevEx note: the demo snippets need SDK pinning.

We’ve had a couple near-misses where a patch release changed streaming defaults and the demo output shifted. If the certification expects exact behavior, we should:
- pin Redwood SDK versions in the demo app
- include “do not upgrade before demos” guidance

Happy to add a section to the Confluence hub and a one-pager for SEs.

Alex
Alex Martinez
Developer Experience

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>; Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>; Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>; Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>; Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>; Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Nov 22, 2025 at 9:05 AM PT
Subject: Re: Demo enablement rollout + certification (required) — switching to Demo Deck v1

Avery: yes — we’ll make “20-min exec” an official certified path.
- Soojin/Camila: please add a single slide with “Exec path” (slides to skip + timing) + a backup screenshot sequence.
- Markus: let’s include it as an option in AE certification (pick 30-min standard OR 20-min exec).

Alex: agree on SDK pinning.
- Please add a “Demo SDK versions” section to the Confluence hub + a simple rule: no upgrades inside 48 hours of a scheduled external demo.
- If a rep asks for a new feature in the live demo that would require an upgrade, we treat that as a planned “v1.0.1” change, not a day-of tweak.

Next step for everyone: reply with the training slot you’re attending by EOD Monday so Ops can size the run-through sessions.

Stephanie Nguyen
VP Sales, North America
Redwood Inference
